rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for deliberately behaving in a challenging or provocative way.

example.english: They always speak to people confrontationally, making the whole room awkward.
example.traditional: 佢成日好挑釁咁同人講嘢，搞到成間房都好尷尬。
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hou2 tiu1 jan6 gam3 tung4 jan4 gong2 je5 gaau2 dou3 sing4 gaan1 fong4 dou1 hou2 gaam3 gaai3

rows.note: Use this when the confrontational manner mainly conveys hostility toward the other person.

example.english: They looked at me confrontationally, making me afraid to speak again.
example.traditional: 佢好有敵意咁望住我，搞到我唔敢再出聲。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hou2 jau5 dik6 ji3 gam3 mong6 zyu6 ngo5 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 m4 gam2 zoi3 ceot1 seng1

rows.note: Use this when someone responds by directly opposing or matching the other side.

example.english: As soon as I raised an objection, they responded confrontationally by arguing straight back at me.
example.traditional: 我一提出反對意見，佢就針鋒相對咁駁返我。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 tai4 ceot1 faan2 deoi3 ji3 gin3 keoi5 zau6 zam1 fung1 soeng1 deoi3 gam3 bok3 faan2 ngo5
